load_box2d_trajectory_from_csv: load 2D bounding box trajectory data from a CSV file and return an ObjectBox2dProvider
parse_box2ds_from_csv_reader: parse a CSV reader into an ObjectBox2dTrajectoryCollection with bounding boxes per stream and timestamp
get_data_statistics: get data statistics including frame counts, stream IDs, and object UIDs from an ObjectBox2dProvider
get_bbox_at_timestamp: query bounding boxes at a specific timestamp for a given camera stream using time query options
get_timestamp_ns_list: get the sorted list of timestamps in nanoseconds for a specific camera stream
